hypothesis: The current signed closed-core attachment Sigma(2) agrees with AMBiT at identical Coulomb integrals, orbital energies, intermediate spaces and fixed external energy; higher-order Q propagation is a separate missing operation.

fixed.reference: Native Ne closed core, Z=10, point nucleus, Dirac-Coulomb, ns=40 ks=7
fixed.virtual: First three VN metric-core-orthogonal roots in each kappa=-1,1,-2,2,-3; no amplitude threshold
fixed.external: Three same-kappa roots per block, kappa=-1,-2,-3
fixed.denominator: One fixed argument per block, first external DF energy; delta=0 and floor=1e-8 Ha; reject reference runs with skipped diagrams
fixed.reference_source: AMBiT fe1115aaed97b340e1f4d625d451b165c5bcd7a5, existing unmodified compiled MBPT library
fixed.matched_scope: AMBiT consumes Atomx's signed radial integral tables, so this isolates independent angular recoupling and diagram sums, not radial-solver accuracy
fixed.units_metric: Hartree, real orthonormal radial spinors, signed scalar matrix elements

gates.finite_Q_anchor_if_implemented: Schur/Dyson full-state energies and normalized eigenvectors match independent full diagonalization to 1e-10 Ha; signed phase and non-diagonal Q mixing covered
gates.scientific_claim: No Yb experimental-accuracy pass follows from an implementation or finite-space gate

stop: Stop before a production Yb scan if the matched Sigma gate fails, the finite-space anchor fails, or the declared dimensions exceed the resource cap; preserve negative evidence and revise the implementation, never the gate.
